review_scope: Independent Astra review of PR #360 (issue 332, feat/bounded-python-library) on base f4e4de69, head 3ea19dfa: a setup-level <execute> loading Python from a uri or inline text, without target or script, is admitted in bounded Build and dry-run after a static library check of the exact source in the bounded child (data-module imports, no reference to file or dynamic-code builtins, introspection or loader attributes, any getattr/setattr/delattr or __getattribute__ reference, or the '__builtins__' key, no imports inside bodies under rngSeed); SQL, bash, target, script and nested execute stay unsupported_bounded_operation; a seeded Build that loads Python forces deterministic replay and names the cause when that forced replay fails; ExecuteStatement owns language inference and inline normalisation. The registry now publishes execute with the additive bounded strategy python_library (capability and DM JSON x-datamimic-bounded-strategy), decided by Alex as Option A; policy, workspace snapshot and include validation dispatch on that strategy. No policy, budget, contract or gate change.

delivery_boundary: Local architecture review accepted for the bound source: zero violations or baseline drift; calls_unresolved 1431, typing_positions 178 and unknown_positions 256 unchanged; all 314 UNKNOWN records (identical identities, reference churn in two records and the DSL-API-TYPES count) and 20 interface.usage_unknown diagnostics remain; native rules 271 PASS and 5 UNKNOWN. The library check is a static admission rule, not a sandbox: admitted module APIs (for example pandas, numpy, logging, typing) can still read or write files or evaluate code, and further object-introspection routes are out of the check's scope; the same holds for existing bounded expressions (pd.DataFrame(...).to_csv to an absolute path wrote outside the workspace in a dry-run on this head), so bounded runs do not prove absence of file side effects. The published execute capability now reports bounded strategy python_library; the contract bundle envelope stays schema_version 1 with no pinned golden, and EE's differently named strategy enum has no CE mapping to update. Not established by this receipt: full CE suites, CE CI, external services, Windows, EE parity, merge and release. The #357 follow-up limits (body-time draws, imports inside bodies in unseeded runs, instance reseeding) are unchanged.
